import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Set Real Ideal Polynomial
open scoped BigOperators

theorem conjugate_zpow_exists_exp {G : Type*} [Group G]
  (hG : ∀ (H : Subgroup G), H.Normal) (a b : G) :
  ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ k : ℤ, b * a ^ n * b⁻¹ = a ^ k := by
  intro n
  have h_mem : a ^ n ∈ Subgroup.zpowers a := Subgroup.mem_zpowers_iff.mpr ⟨n, rfl⟩
  have h_conj := (hG (Subgroup.zpowers a)).conj_mem (a ^ n) h_mem b
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Subgroup.mem_zpowers_iff.mp h_conj
  refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
  first | exact hk | exact hk.symm
